changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.observation_history (id, patient_id, sample_id, sample_item_id, observation_history_type_id, value_type, value, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.observation_history_seq'), v.patient_id, v.sample_id, v.sample_item_id, env.id, v.value_type, v.value, now() FROM clinlims.observation_history v JOIN clinlims.observation_history_type vt ON vt.id = v.observation_history_type_id AND vt.type_name = 'vecWorkflowType' JOIN clinlims.observation_history_type env ON env.type_name = 'envWorkflowType' WHERE v.sample_id IS NOT NULL AND v.value IN ('vector', 'environmental') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.observation_history e WHERE e.sample_id = v.sample_id AND e.observation_history_type_id = env.id)
